# Release It! for Codex

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/release-it/ in the guided-plugins repository.

- Skills: 31 workflow and rule skills plus 6 mode skills, invoked as `$release-it:<name>` or from `/skills`.
- Subagents: 21 roles in `../agents/release-it-*.toml`. Codex plugins cannot bundle subagents, so install them with `node scripts/install-codex-agents.mjs release-it`.
- Always-on rules: see `../../rules/release-it/`.

Full instructions: docs/AGENTS_SUPPORT.md in the repository.
